Interface JMSMessageObserver

All Superinterfaces:
io.micronaut.core.order.Ordered
All Known Implementing Classes:
JMSMetrics, JMSTracing
public interface JMSMessageObserver extends io.micronaut.core.order.Ordered
Observes the messages that JMS listeners process and that JMS producers send, for example to record metrics or traces. Each observer bean is called before a message is processed or sent, and completes the observation that it returns afterwards. Observers are called in order and their observations are completed in the reverse order. An observer that throws an exception is logged and skipped. One that throws an Error stops the processing or the send: the observations already started are completed with the error, which is rethrown.
Since:
5.2.0

    • send

      default @Nullable JMSObservation send(JMSDestinationType destinationType, String destination)
      Called before a producer sends a message, before the connection is taken from the pool and the message is created, so a send that fails to connect is observed too. Once the message is created and its headers are set, the observation's JMSObservation.beforeSend(Message) is called with it, so properties added to the message are sent with it.
      Parameters:
      destinationType - The type of the destination
      destination - The name of the destination the message is sent to
      Returns:
      The observation to complete once the message is sent or the send failed, or null
